import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

threes=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(o) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==3]
print('in dots:',sorted(twos)); print('out threes:',threes)
for r in range(14):
    print(''.join(map(str,o[r])))

import os,re,json

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

import collections, json

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rs=collections.defaultdict(int); cs=collections.defaultdict(int)
    for r,c in dots: rs[r]+=1; cs[c]+=1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if sum(cs.values())>=2 and len(dots)>=2:
        axis='col'
        cb=max(cs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        rowsd=[r for r,c in dots if c==cb]
        lo,hi=min(rowsd),max(rowsd)
        # spine vertical segment; keep dots as-is
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            v=out[r][cb]
            out[r][cb]=3 if v==0 else 2
        others=[(r,c) for r,c in dots if c!=cb]
        for r,c in others:
            lo,hi=min(c,cb),max(c,cb)
            for cc in range(lo,hi+1):
                out[r][cc]=3
    else:
        sr=max(rs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        colsd=[c for r,c in dots if r==sr]
        lo,hi=min(colsd),max(colsd)
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            v=out[sr][c]
            out[sr][c]=3 if v==0 else 2
        others=[(r,c) for r,c in dots if r!=sr]
        for r,c in others:
            lo,hi=min(r,sr),max(r,sr)
            for rr in range(lo,hi+1):
                out[rr][c]=3
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=solve(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match:',p==o)
res=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

import collections, json

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    dots=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    rs=collections.defaultdict(int); cs=collections.defaultdict(int)
    for r,c in dots: rs[r]+=1; cs[c]+=1
    if max(cs.values())>=2:  # column spine
        cb=max(cs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        coldots=sorted(c for r,c in dots if c==cb)
        for r in range(min(coldots),max(coldots)+1):
            out[r][cb]=3 if out[r][cb]==0 else 2
        for r,c in dots:
            if c==cb: continue
            near=min(dots,key=lambda d2:abs(d2[1]-c))
            for cc in range(min(c,near[1]),max(c,near[1])+1):
                out[r][cc]=3
    else:  # row spine
        sr=max(rs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        rowsd=sorted({c for r,c in dots if r==sr})
        for c in range(min(rowsd),max(rowsd)+1):
            out[sr][c]=3 if out[sr][c]==0 else 2
        for r,c in dots:
            if r==sr: continue
            near=min(dots,key=lambda d2:abs(d2[0]-r))
            for rr in range(min(r,near[0]),max(r,near[0])+1):
                out[rr][c]=3
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=solve(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    print(k,'match:',p==o)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import collections,json
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rs=collections.defaultdict(list); cs=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in twos: rs[r].append(c); cs[c].append(r)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    def fill(a,b):
        lo,hi=min(a,b)+1,max(a,b)
        for x in range(lo,hi):
            if 0<=x<H and 0<=b<W: out[x][b]=3
    # case A: spine exists
    if any(len(v)>=2 for v in rs.values()):
        # row spine: max count row
        sr=max(rs.items(),key=lambda kv:(len(kv[1]),-kv[0]))[0]
        colds=sorted(set(cs.get(x,[]) for x in colds:=[]))
        for c in range(min({c for r,c in twos}),max({c for r,c in twos})+1):
            out[sr][c]=3 if out[sr][c]!=2 else 2
        for r,c in twos:
            if r==sr: continue
            # vertical segment to spine row
            for rr in range(min(r,sr)+1,max(r,sr)):
                out[rr][c]=3
    else:
        # no spine: hub = earliest dot; C = hub column
        hub=min(twos)
        C=hub[1]
        twos_sorted=sorted(twos)
        for i,d in enumerate(twos_sorted):
            n=min([p for p in twos if p!=d], key=lambda q:max(abs(q[0]-d[0]),abs(q[1]-d[1])))
            # horizontal arm from d toward C
            lo,hi=min(d[1],C)+1,max(d[1],C)
            for cc in range(lo,hi): out[d[0]][cc]=3
            # vertical arm from n toward (d[0],C)
            rr_lo,rr_hi=min(n[0],d[0])+1,max(n[0],d[0])
            for rr in range(rr_lo,rr_hi): out[rr][C]=3
        for r,c in twos: out[r][c]=2
    return out
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    p=f(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    m=p==o; ok&=m
    print(k,'match:',m)
    if not m:
        for r in range(len(o)):

print('ALL:',ok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rs=collections.defaultdict(int);cs=collections.defaultdict(int)
    for r,c in pts: rs[r]+=1; cs[c]+=1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=2
    # prefer row-axis spine; fall back to column
    if max(rs.values()):
        sr=max(rs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        ecs=sorted({c for r,c in pts if r==sr})
        lo,hi=ecs[0],ecs[-1]
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            if not any(p==(sr,c) for p in pts): out[sr][c]=3
        for r,c in pts:
            if r==sr: continue
            st,ed=(r+1,sr) if r<sr else (sr,r-1)
            for x in range(st,ed+1): out[x][c]=3
    elif max(cs.values()):
        scol=max(cs.items(),key=lambda kv:(kv[1],-kv[0]))[0]
        recs=sorted({r for r,c in pts})
        for r in range(recs[0],recs[-1]+1):
            if not any(p==(r,scol) for p in pts): out[r][scol]=3
        for r,c in pts:
            if c!=scol:
                for x in range(min(c,scol)+1,max(c,scol)): out[r][x]=3
    return out
